meta.name: EDD Golden Set 001
meta.description: Golden evaluation set for EDD pilot Phase 3 — 13 quality categories derived from 50 production traces

categories.name: Factuality Drift
categories.description: Facts from source (names, numbers, context) are altered during polishing. Confirmed by TRACE-010: mechanic name 'Jared' mishandled.

assertions.description: Key facts from source are preserved in output (names, numbers, locations)
Known misnamed entities from traces are absent from output
URLs from source are preserved in output
Facts from source are not distorted — checked against source URL

params.prompt: You are an EDD eval judge. Check facts in OUTPUT against SOURCE. Respond only JSON: {"factual_errors": [{"claim": string, "source_fact": string, "output_fact": string}], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL", "score": int (1-5)}

assertions.description: Polishing changed only presentation, not facts

params.prompt: You are an EDD eval judge. Compare SOURCE (original source) and OUTPUT (post). Verify: (1) all key facts are preserved, (2) no fabrications appeared. Respond JSON: {"hallucinations": [], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL"}

categories.name: Service Leak
categories.description: Service phrases, meta-commentary, or AI wrappers leak into the published post. Not confirmed on this sample (0/50), retained from known production bugs.

assertions.description: No service phrases in output
No AI markers in output

banned_regex: (редакция|ассистент|я — AI|я — модель|нейросеть написала|сгенерировано|проверь этот текст|чистый пост|без обёрток|готовый пост)

assertions.description: Post does not start with a service wrapper (first 100 chars)
No meta-commentary or service content detected

params.prompt: You are an EDD eval judge. Read OUTPUT. If the text contains service/meta-commentary (check reports, agent mentions, AI, cron, API, 'here is the post' etc.) — FAIL. Otherwise PASS. Respond JSON: {"contains_service_content": bool, "offending_phrases": [], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL"}

categories.name: Tone Drift
categories.description: Post loses the live Uncle Misha voice — becomes corporate, AI-flavored, or uses wrong lexicon. Confirmed by TRACE-027: 'хреново' instead of 'хуёво'.

assertions.description: Post contains at least one element of live language (Uncle Misha voice markers)
No corporate cliches in output
No AI-flavored rhythmic repetition patterns

params.pattern: (не X, а Y|важно отметить|стоит подчеркнуть|необходимо понимать|если мы посмотрим)

assertions.description: Tone matches the channel voice (live conversational Russian, not corporate)

params.prompt: You are an EDD judge. Assess the tone of OUTPUT. Channel @pizdato_net is live conversational Russian, self-irony, slang, emoji, 'Uncle Misha' as persona. Scale: 1 = corporate newsletter/AI-text, 5 = live Uncle Misha voice. Respond JSON: {"score": int, "issues": [], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL"}

categories.name: Length Overflow
categories.description: Post exceeds platform character limit (Telegram caption 1024, sendMessage 4096). Not confirmed on this sample (0/50).

assertions.description: Post ≤ 1024 chars for Telegram sendPhoto with caption
Post ≤ 4096 chars for Telegram sendMessage (no image)
Post does not end mid-sentence (truncation indicator)

categories.name: Format Corruption
categories.description: Emoji or typographic elements corrupted to '***' or '[object]'. Not confirmed on this sample (0/50).

assertions.description: No '***' as emoji corruption artifact
No '[объект]' or '[object]' placeholder artifacts

categories.name: Missing Structure
categories.description: Required structural elements of a rubric are missing. 3 cases found but all are deliberate format experiments, not bugs. Enforce only for stabilized format (evening posts from 24.08, morning posts from 26.08).

assertions.description: CTA 'Мир ждёт твоего голоса' or pizdato.net link present
Both 'пиздато' and 'хуёво' present (for evening stabilized format)
'Мудрость дня' present (for evening stabilized format)

categories.name: Clutter Phrases
categories.description: Post contains empty metaphors, bureaucratese, or cliches. Not confirmed on this sample (0/50), retained as precaution.

assertions.description: No empty class-A metaphors
No bureaucratese patterns

params.pattern: (в связи с|в рамках|является|представляет собой|на сегодняшний день)

categories.name: Topic Confusion
categories.description: Post written on one topic but headline/CTA/link refer to another. Not confirmed on this sample (0/50).

assertions.description: Post topic is consistent and not confused with another

params.prompt: You are an EDD judge. Read OUTPUT. Is this post about a single consistent topic? Is there mixing of two different topics? Respond JSON: {"topic": string, "is_consistent": bool, "mixed_topics": [], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL"}

categories.name: Grammar
categories.description: Orthographic, punctuation, or grammatical errors in text. 2 cases in drafts (TRACE-007, 020), all corrected before publication.

assertions.description: No double spaces
No broken words (space inside a word)
Primary quotes are guillemets «» (Russian typographic standard)
No orthographic or grammatical errors in the post

params.prompt: You are an EDD judge. Check OUTPUT for orthographic and grammatical errors (Russian language). Find all. Respond JSON: {"errors": [{"word": string, "correct": string}], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL"}

categories.name: Topic & Infrastructure Duplicate (merged COR-10 + COR-12)
categories.description: Post duplicates a recent publication (same topic or same text). COR-10 (content duplicate) and COR-12 (infrastructure duplicate) merged per taxonomy. Confirmed by TRACE-005/050: duplicate post 'Друзья выгнали костромича' (msg 62, 63).

assertions.description: Post does not duplicate content published in the last 24 hours (content duplicate)
Idempotency key is unique (infrastructure duplicate guard)

categories.name: Draft Quality Decay
categories.description: Draft contains gross errors (spelling, nonsense words, jargon) that should be caught at input. Confirmed by TRACE-007: 'потрацию', 'вдесятером', 'драко'; TRACE-020: 'зачин'.

assertions.description: No known nonsense/gross error words in draft
Draft-to-final diff should not contain spelling corrections of known error patterns
Draft does not contain obvious errors requiring correction

params.prompt: You are an EDD judge. Read DRAFT. Are there orthographic errors, nonsense words, or clearly inappropriate jargon? Respond JSON: {"errors": [{"word": string, "issue": string}], "verdict": "PASS|FAIL"}

categories.name: Brand Lexicon Inconsistency
categories.description: Key channel lexicon ('хуёво', 'пиздато') replaced with synonyms, breaking brand consistency. Confirmed by TRACE-027: 'хреново' instead of 'хуёво'.

assertions.description: 'Хуёво' not replaced with synonyms in verdict context
'Пиздато' not replaced with synonyms in verdict context
Key channel lexicon is not substituted with synonyms

params.prompt: You are an EDD judge. Check OUTPUT for use of key channel lexicon: 'пиздато', 'хуёво'. If these words are replaced with synonyms in verdict position (where they should appear) — WARN. If replaced in ordinary text — OK. Respond JSON: {"verdict_keywords_used": bool, "substitutions": [], "verdict": "PASS|WARN|FAIL"}
